samples.evidence: Visible PayPal login URL is attached to an external numeric-IP href, under a user-home path padded with repeated dot-space segments. The official PayPal anchor is camouflage; there is no local harvest form, so the detection describes deceptive link delivery rather than proven submission.
samples.change: Require brand/destination deception and nearby padding; numeric-IP/user-home/padding observations alone no longer establish hostile intent.

samples.identity: launcher.dll PlayGame export drops WannaCry; embedded worm infected with Virut CE

evidence.launcher: PlayGame at VA 0x1800011a4 builds C:\WINDOWS\mssecsvc.exe, extracts length-prefixed W/101 resource through FindResource/LoadResource/LockResource, writes it with CreateFileA/WriteFile, and launches the same path with CreateProcessA (CREATE_NO_WINDOW).
evidence.WannaCry: Embedded tasksche main at 0x401fe7 copies itself, extracts password-protected resource members with WNcry@2ol7, hides its directory, grants Everyone full access, decrypts t.wnry and maps its TaskStart export. Recovered msg/m_english.wnry contains file-encryption extortion and Bitcoin payment demands. Local ZIP headers were recovered and ZipCrypto/deflate decoded without executing the PE.
evidence.Virut: Embedded PE at outer offset 0xc8a8 enters VA 0xa71734 in writable executable .rsrc. Its loader performs distinctive kernel-image validation, PEB/export walking and h=15*h-character hashing. Extra polymorphic instructions split the pointer-update and subtraction operations; the old hash matcher omitted these gaps.
evidence.corroboration: User supplied MalwareBazaar WannaCry and VirusTotal 54/70. Public pages were not retrievable during this review; judgement rests on inspected behavior, not that prior.

samples.change: Allow bounded instruction gaps in the existing export-hash signature. Add a Virut composite requiring family validation, export hashing, resource entry and executable resource permissions.

samples.identity: Gutcheck 0.18.0 Windows diagnostics PowerShell module by MERLIN
samples.evidence: All shipped scripts are readable diagnostics, check definitions, reporting and support code. UAC elevation uses RunAs; user switching creates an Interactive/Limited task and removes it in finally. Updates use Install-Module, authentication uses Microsoft device flow, Graph requests fetch check definitions from a configured SharePoint document, optional token caching uses Windows protection, and results are local HTML/CSV. No credential theft, covert report upload, destructive payload or unauthorized persistence identified.
samples.change: Move generic User-Agent, WinHTTP, ipconfig, TimeCreated sorting, display resolution and registry-hive references out of attacker/write claims; update exact consumers. Reject PowerShell variable interpolation as a literal punctuation-leading username. Require Domain= value syntax for cookie attributes, not semicolon-delimited diagnostic object fields. Tighten Rundll32 command syntax against multiline prose and describe it as a reference. Restrict abbreviation flag matcher to actual abbreviations. Disable the third-party scheduled-task rule whose precedence bypasses its claimed suspicious-directory gate. Add structured SecureString conversion calls as notable cryptographic capability, without guessing encryption direction or key provider.

controls: cases.json records positive and near-miss fixtures. PE fixtures are inert (entry returns) and contain unreachable signature fragments, not specimen code.
scope_and_consumers: Exact references follow moved atoms; the display inventory moved as a whole while other hardware rules remain. Ancestor selectors were audited: generic HTTP-name and hive-reference evidence no longer qualifies as script-eval or registry-write intent. Discovery selectors lose generic display/IP references deliberately; OS-neutral reference findings remain visible. Existing Python-only profile consumers cannot depend on the moved batch/PowerShell ipconfig atom; generic event sorting is still referenced explicitly by the RDP composite.
limits: Static inspection only. rizin used for control flow and PE extraction; binwalk is not installed in this environment. No samples were executed.

judgement_markers.summary: PayPal phishing lure: require deceptive label on padded IP link
WannaCry/Virut launcher: detect polymorphic resource-entry infection
Gutcheck diagnostics: correct neutral traits and remove false positives
